message.content: I usually wake up around nine, like clockwork. My sister makes me breakfast most days—porridge with some fruit. I don’t eat much, to be honest. Then I get dressed, take a bus to the shop. The route is the same every day, so I don’t get lost. I like the routine, it helps me feel… steady. Sometimes, though, I hear a voice on the bus. It’s not loud, just… there. I don’t know what it’s saying, but it’s not threatening. I just try to ignore it and focus on the ride. Once I get to work, I start pricing notebooks, restocking pens, counting the till. It’s simple work, but it keeps me occupied.
